description: Blumira cloud SIEM + XDR: query security findings, evidence, detection rules, agent devices, and users across a direct org or every MSP sub-account, then resolve/assign/comment on findings.

env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_API_TOKEN
env_var_specs.description: Blumira JWT bearer token. Minted+cached by `auth login`, or set directly. Set this OR BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID + BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET.

env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID
env_var_specs.description: Blumira API Client ID (Settings > Organization > Generate API Credentials). Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET by `auth login` to mint a JWT.

env_var_specs.name: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET
env_var_specs.description: Blumira API Client Secret. Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID by `auth login` to mint a JWT (client_credentials, audience=public-api).
